name: The Souls of the Oak
summary: The faces in the oak are the souls of those beheaded before it, and they want to be let go.

stages.journal: In the Witching Hour the carved faces of the oak opened their eyes and spoke to us. They are the souls of the beheaded.
stages.hint: Return to the oak at the Witching Hour when the party is stronger.

stages.journal: The oak woke to defend its souls and we have had to fight it.
The faces left the bark one by one. The oak is only a tree.
